name: WF-440 — Seller Negotiation Finalization → Contract Readiness / Walk-Away / Nurture Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const negotiationId=String(b.negotiationId??'').trim(); const outcome=String(b.outcome??b.eventType??'').trim().toLowerCase(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,dealId,negotiationId,outcome,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Negotiation Finalization').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const outcome=input.outcome; const blockedStates=['closed','cancelled','disputed','dnc','suppressed']; const dealState=String(ctx.dealState??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); const flags=[]; if(blockedStates.includes(dealState)||ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true)flags.push('deal_or_contact_blocked'); const protectedMao=n(ctx.protectedMao); const finalPrice=n(ctx.finalPurchasePrice??ctx.purchasePrice??ctx.acceptedPrice); const sellerAccepted=ctx.sellerAccepted===true||['accepted','contract_ready','accepted_final'].includes(outcome); const contractReadiness=ctx.contractReadiness??{}; const identityVerified=contractReadiness.sellerIdentityVerified===true&&contractReadiness.propertyIdentityVerified===true; const documentsReady=contractReadiness.requiredDocumentsReady===true; const signaturesReady=contractReadiness.requiredSignaturesReady===true; const titleReady=contractReadiness.titleCompanyConfirmed===true; const economicsReady=finalPrice>0&&(protectedMao<=0||finalPrice<=protectedMao); const readinessScore=[sellerAccepted,identityVerified,documentsReady,signaturesReady,titleReady,economicsReady].filter(Boolean).length/6; let decision='human_review',nextAction='review_negotiation_finalization',pipelineState='negotiation'; if(flags.length){decision='blocked';nextAction='stop_negotiation_and_contract_flow';pipelineState='blocked';}else if(['rejected','walk_away','seller_rejected'].includes(outcome)){decision='walk_away';nextAction='move_to_reengagement_or_nurture';pipelineState='nurture';}else if(['no_response','stalled','max_rounds_reached'].includes(outcome)){decision='nurture';nextAction='schedule_reengagement_sequence';pipelineState='nurture';}else if(sellerAccepted){if(!economicsReady){decision='walk_away';nextAction='reject_or_reprice_above_protected_mao';pipelineState='walk_away';}else if(readinessScore===1){decision='contract_ready';nextAction='advance_to_contract_generation_and_signature';pipelineState='contract_ready';}else{decision='contract_readiness_pending';nextAction='collect_missing_contract_readiness_items';pipelineState='contract_readiness';}}else{decision='human_review';nextAction='resolve_unfinalized_negotiation';pipelineState='negotiation';} const missing=[]; if(!sellerAccepted)missing.push('seller_acceptance'); if(!contractReadiness.sellerIdentityVerified)missing.push('seller_identity_verification'); if(!contractReadiness.propertyIdentityVerified)missing.push('property_identity_verification'); if(!documentsReady)missing.push('required_documents'); if(!signaturesReady)missing.push('required_signatures'); if(!titleReady)missing.push('title_company_confirmation'); if(!economicsReady)missing.push('protected_mao_economics'); const idempotencyKey='wf440:'+input.leadId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.negotiationId+':'+outcome; return [{json:{...input,negotiationFinalizationDecision:{status:flags.length?'review_required':'evaluated',decision,nextAction,pipelineState,finalPurchasePrice:finalPrice,protectedMao,economicsReady,readinessScore,missingRequirements:missing,flags,requiresHumanReview:decision==='human_review'||decision==='contract_readiness_pending',confidenceScore:flags.length?15:(decision==='human_review'?55:95)},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Negotiation finalization and contract readiness is scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM contract-readiness schema, canonical protected-MAO source, e-signature/document provider, title/closing provider, and production API contracts.
